title: Chapter 247 Meeting
content:
Chapter 247 Meeting

A few people rode fast horses, and in a short time, about ten minutes, they came to the front of the tent, and stopped a hundred meters away from the tent under the interception of a group of guards.

The commander led Xiaoyaozi to dismount, came to the gate of the tent, and said something to the guards, probably some words about returning from orders and asking for an audience.

The guard commander looked at Xiaoyaozi and the others coldly, his eyes were sharp and deep. When he looked at Xiaoyaozi and the others, they felt a feeling of being seen through and full of crisis.

The guard commander in front of him turned out to be a first-class master, Xiaoyaozi and the others felt a little surprised.

You must know that every first-class master is often the head of a power in the Jianghu, either the elders among the various university factions, or the famous generals of one side, all of them occupy high positions.

Like that commander, he can only serve as a gatekeeper and stand guard for others. It is really demeaning and condescending.

However, this can also be used to see how powerful the Yu Kingdom is, and it is possible to use a first-class strong man as an ordinary soldier, and make that strong man willing.

Thinking of this, Xiaoyaozi turned his head and looked beside him. He just came to invite his cavalry commander, but he was also a second-rate master, and he was still a second-rate master. Even among the major sects, he was only a first-class backbone.

Looking ahead, the hundreds of soldiers who surrounded the big tent tightly, never leaving, guarding the safety of the tent conscientiously, were all third-rate masters, with successful internal strength.

This was another event that amazed Xiaoyaozi and others. Among other things, just looking at the guards next to the tent, he was already no less than a first-class martial art in the world.

If you think about it again, these guards still work in shifts, which means that there are at least the same number of guards, and even more people did not come because of shifts and went to rest, which made them feel even more chilling.

This Yuguo has such a profound background, just this one guard of King Jing is no less than the strength of a school in Jianghu, it can be said to be extremely strong.

Thoughts were flying in their hearts, Xiaoyaozi and the others had thousands of thoughts in their minds, constantly thinking about the comparison between their own strength and Yu Guo's. As well as thinking about how to face King Jing who is going to meet next, as well as the strategy of getting along with Yuguo, they also need to make adjustments.

Just when Xiaoyaozi and the others were contemplating and their minds were numb, the guard general in front, under the general report of the cavalry commander, nodded his head, turned around and ordered a few guards to go to the big tent to report up.

Not long after, the guards hurried over and whispered a few words next to the general. The general nodded, then said a few words to the cavalry commander, and then signaled the soldiers behind him to get out of the way.

The commander of the cavalry looked overjoyed, knowing that his mission had been completed, this time, he should be able to count some credit for it!

"Several distinguished guests, the king has received the notice and is waiting in the big tent, please come with me!" The commander had a happy face, and he couldn't help but smug in his tone.

"So, please lead the way!" Xiaoyaozi nodded and said to the commander.

Afterwards, the three of them followed the commander to the gate of the camp, but the commander was stopped by several soldiers guarding the gate, and only Xiaoyaozi and the other three were let in.

The commander also knew that in his own capacity, he was not qualified to enter unless there were special circumstances, so he obeyed obediently and stood by the side waiting for Xiaoyaozi and the others to come out.

...

Inside the tent, a row of candles were lit, and the roof of the tent was opened with skylights, and the surrounding windows were left open. The tent that was supposed to be dark seemed brightly lit.

Xiaoyaozi and the others entered the camp all the way, and as soon as they stepped in, they were greeted with a magnificent scene. In this army, on the battlefield, there is such a rich and noble place, which made them feel secretly surprised .

However, it also made them feel a little disdainful.

As the leader of an army, at the moment of the war, he still covets these extraneous enjoyments, instead of using the money, buys some money, food and equipment for the army, and instead uses it for enjoyment, he is really a fool.

However, with many years of experience in the arena, and seeing so many old-fashioned people, naturally he would not show it easily, nor would he really believe that Prince Jing in front of him is such a person who enjoys himself.

They didn't forget that it was the person in front of them who single-handedly contributed to the formation of the alliance, and commanded hundreds of thousands of troops, and confronted Qin Guolai several times head-on, without losing the wind.

Such a person, even if he really indulges in enjoyment, is just an appearance, and he is definitely a sinister person with deep wisdom.

Xiaoyaozi and the others raised their heads, looked into the tent, scanned their eyes a few times, and finally concentrated on the only figure in the tent, that is, the figure sitting on the high throne directly in front of them.

"Xiaoyaozi of the Taoist school, Moban of the Mohist school, Tian Guang of the farmer's family, His Highness Jianguo Jingwang, and His Highness Wan'an!" The three of Xiaoyaozi bowed to the figure in unison.

However, there was a tinge of doubt in their hearts. As the current commander of the entire coalition army, the famous King Jing dared to be alone with the three of them, without anyone around him to protect him.

Even if there are hundreds of troops outside the camp, if the three of them are really careless, does Prince Jing really have the confidence to guarantee his own safety?

In fact, the three of them were a bit overwhelmed. As a high-ranking king, Zhong Yu was naturally very concerned about his own safety. How could he take it lightly when he approached the rulers of these three schools this time!

Although he is very confident that his strength is close to the fifth level, if the three people in front of him are really worried, it will definitely be overwhelmed for him. But just in case, he still arranged eight fourth-tier masters in the dark of the camp, in some imperceptible shadows, to guard against the three of them.

With this kind of strict protection, coupled with the hundreds of troops outside the camp, and his own strength, he naturally didn't care about the threat that these three people could pose to him.

"Get up, I've heard about the three names for a long time, and I've been looking forward to it for a long time. It's finally hard for me to tell you all, but it's because of my busy schedule that I neglected you all. Please don't blame me!" Zhong Yurang smiled slightly. Xiaoyaozi and the others got up, and incidentally said a few words of innocuous apology.

But Xiaoyaozi and the others really dared to take this apology seriously, got up quickly, and then responded.

"Where? The king has a lot of opportunities every day. It is a great honor and kindness to be able to find time to meet us grassroots. How can we dare to ask for anything else!"
